title: Complete homepage Next steps with prerequisites list and ask scope
summary: Audience: first-time readers of the generated homepage. next_steps in xtask/src/site.rs already has the clone command and a prerequisites sentence. I'll turn the prerequisites into a list and add a line that `athena ask` acts on the git repository in the current directory. I'll extend the test in xtask/tests/site_page.rs to assert the clone command and the list.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the rendered page text and the test, fmt and clippy runs.
cargo test, fmt and clippy are required to pass.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read xtask/src/site.rs next_steps (lines 541-565), xtask/tests/site_page.rs (lines 180-202), xtask/src/main.rs setup() (lines 181-230) and crates/athena-cli/src/wiring.rs:176 (Git::discover(cwd)). No records, AnyRecord or refusal rules are involved. No crates/ data files are added.
The clone command and a prerequisites sentence already exist, so the remaining work is the list form, the current-directory statement, and strengthened tests.

I could not read setup.sh (blocked by the path policy). Its only visible dependency is curl, from a grep that returned a single curl line, so I rely on main.rs setup() for the prerequisites. The producer should re-check setup.sh and claude/npm needs in the repo.
Existing unit tests in xtask/src/site.rs (around lines 1536-1538) may assert the old sentence wording and need keeping in step.

acceptance_criteria.text: In xtask/src/site.rs, next_steps renders the prerequisites as an HTML list (nested <ul>/<li>) naming git 2.40 or later, a C linker (cc), curl, and Claude Code (or npm to install it). These match the checks in xtask/src/main.rs setup().

The rendered Next steps include a sentence that `athena ask` acts on the git repository in the current directory. This is backed by Git::discover(cwd) in crates/athena-cli/src/wiring.rs, which errors with 'Athena runs inside a git repository'.
xtask/tests/site_page.rs asserts the rendered Next steps section contains `git clone https://github.com/doodla/athena.git`, the prerequisites list items, and the current-directory sentence.
Run `cargo test -p xtask`. The site_page tests and the unit tests in xtask/src/site.rs all pass, including the existing assertions on setup.sh and `athena ask "add a changelog"`.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`. Both pass.
The diff touches only the Next steps text and its tests, plus the CHANGELOG.md entry. No other page section or behavior changes.

out_of_scope: Changes to setup.sh or to athena ask behavior
departures: The change is small and the clone command and prerequisites sentence already exist, so cost and time are below the reference.
